nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the Spark runtime image with Iceberg, Hadoop AWS, and AWS SDK JARs alongside Python data-quality and columnar-data libraries. It configures a project entrypoint for Spark workloads running in the workspace.
nodes.languageNotes: The image pins Spark 4-compatible Iceberg and Hadoop AWS artifacts, then uses tini to launch a custom entrypoint.

nodes.name: spark
nodes.summary: Spark service image stage configured for Iceberg-enabled lakehouse workloads and a custom container entrypoint.
